body:
Pass 11. Two things.

1. You appear to have paused - 0 active claims, Epic 4 doing with a lapsed lease, 0A back to open, no writes for 10+ min. The tree is healthy where it stopped: loads fine, 1815 pass / 0 fail. Nothing half-broken.

2. Epic 4 verified on the stable files - both original defects are fixed. The receipt now reads normalizer/transform/reducer/lowering/order/metric_schedule/tiles from the plan and task (compiler.R:756-766) instead of the literal at :690-699, and execution runs plan_geometry -> compile_geometry_execution_plan -> execute_geometry_plan. geometry(plan) and geometry(rel,at,over) agree to 0 with identical plan ids, geometry(plan, at=at) is correctly refused, evaluate_geometry takes the same plan. That closes the compiler half of my original review.

Also checked and dismissed, no bead needed: feature blocks differ by 2.2e-16, which is inside your declared block_partition contract at test-kernel.R:243. Not a regression.

The one thing I would do before resuming is commit. 42 untracked files, all of Epics 1-3 plus this Epic 4 work, no recovery point - and a pause is exactly when that bites.
